source.title: Cited galaxy-cluster stop for the Cosmic road trip tour
source.acknowledgment: This research has made use of the NASA/IPAC Extragalactic Database (NED), which is funded by the National Aeronautics and Space Administration and operated by the California Institute of Technology.
source.notes: Position, uncertainties, redshift and reference codes are NED's Preferred values copied verbatim from the ObjectLookup JSON on the retrieval date; NED redshifts are heliocentric, and sexagesimalJ2000 is the same position as printed by NED's classic object search page that day. scripts/prepare_tours.py converts the redshift to a Planck18 comoving distance on the catalog's axes with no peculiar-velocity or frame correction and writes desiMembers: accepted DR1 rows within radiusDeg of the center and redshiftWindow of the redshift, a plausibility check for the framing, not a membership catalog.
